text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally here, the Holy Hoof 
Festival! 
And our live concert, too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, we're gonna put everything we've 
practiced into this and give it our 
all...! 
It really is just like a race."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Yup! It's a race to see who can deliver 
the most cheers! 
Maya and the gang are gonna hype everyone 
up way more!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Mayano! Let's do one more 
run-through before the real thing!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Okay~! Well then, see you at the concert! 
Let's both look super cool out there!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"......A run-through? What are they 
planning to do?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh, we can't let our guard down around 
them, huh? 
Maybe we should get in an extra rehearsal 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, the time has finally come to 
debut 
the band we poured our absolute all into!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Here we go, 『Never Looking Back』!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Ama & Brian
text_block_list.text:
"『Even on days when nothing goes right 
and I wanna cry—!!』"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Haah... After all that training, she's 
still ready to tear me apart... 
Jeez, this beast is something else...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Even so. Even against someone so 
thick-skinned, so massive, so seemingly 
unbeatable. 
Even against you... I... we Umamusume 
will—!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...Hishiama-san. 
I-I will, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Roar!! Reach out!! Snatch it away!! 
Turn up the heat!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Fill "me" up completely!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: —Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators & Hishi Amazon's Group
text_block_list.text:
—"Never Looking Back! That's right, 
never!! 
—Don't look back, Believe Myself!!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Brian and the others are just so cool to 
watch! 
Their outfits, their voices, their 
presence... every single thing about 
them!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(The eyes of everyone in the crowd 
are sparkling so bright—)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —But that goes for us, too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Here we go, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Umm, next up is... "Witch Girl"? Wow, what 
a cute title~! 
Is it a pop song with a dreamy, fluffy 
vibe? Since it's Mayano-chan—
(THUD, THUD, THUD, THUD, THUD—BADUM!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That sound is scary. 
What just started...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Casting aside the world and all its 
mercy, the black cat Mayano walks alone. 
Yet, she carried a single dream she could 
never throw away.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—I just wanna eat delicious food and laze 
around sleeping all day, meow.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how depraved. How utterly greedy. 
Appearing before her was none other than 
the Great Sorceress, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Life isn't that easy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A logical point. Ah, truly sound logic! 
The black cat's spirit breaks just a 
teeeeny bit! 
However... However, the cat will not give 
up!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Is that so, meow~...? Guess I'll do my 
best then!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Don't give up so easily!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*. And so, to earn her daily fish 
allowance, 
the black cat decided to become the 
witch's apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Cat. I understand the urge to be lazy. 
There are days when walls stand in your 
way and you cannot move forward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
However, fear not! 
The Great Sorceress Pearl will teach you a 
very special spell!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! Step!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Step!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~! 
That was a fine warm-up exercise!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That had nothing to do with magic?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Now that our bodies are warmed up. 
Here we go, magic incantation! One, two, 
three, four!
